parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Use a demand and supply diagram to demonstrate how ‘a series of typhoons’ affected the
market price of food crops in Southeast Asia in January 2023.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Is the short-run price elasticity of supply of red onions elastic or inelastic? Justify your answer.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
With the help of a production possibility curve (PPC) diagram, consider the impact on the
opportunity cost to a farmer in the Philippines of starting to grow red onions.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text:
Assess whether a ‘suggested retail price’ is the best way of stabilising onion prices in the
Philippines.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:
Assess the extent to which the increase in onion prices is likely to have affected all households
equally in the Philippines. 
Section B
Answer one question.
EITHER

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain what these estimates mean for producers of smartphones that use semi-conductors
and consider the significance of the long-run estimate.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess the likely effects on resource allocation of a continuing increase in demand for
semi-conductors. 
OR

text: Semi-conductors are widely used in the production of many types of electronic goods such as
smartphones. It has been estimated that the price elasticity of supply for semi-conductors is 0.2 in
the short run and 0.8 in the long run.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain what is meant by a merit good and why governments provide merit goods such as
healthcare free of charge and consider why such provision may not always be successful.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess whether a charge made for healthcare at the point of use is likely to be more beneficial
to consumers and providers than if healthcare is available to all free of charge. 
Section C
Answer one question.
EITHER

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Explain two causes of economic growth and consider the extent to which their impact can be
measured.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess the extent to which economic growth is always beneficial for the people and
government in an economy. 
OR

parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
The terms of trade index for an economy changed from 105 to 110 in a given year.
Explain two likely reasons for this change and consider the extent to which the change is
likely to benefit the current account of the balance of payments of this economy.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Assess whether government policy can influence an economy’s comparative advantage in a
good or service.
